content_items_scope_chain.name: content_items_scope_chain
content_items_scope_chain.value:
(
        ("content_items"."topic_id" IS NOT NULL AND "content_items"."chapter_id" IS NOT NULL AND "content_items"."subject_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("content_items"."topic_id" IS NULL AND "content_items"."chapter_id" IS NOT NULL AND "content_items"."subject_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("content_items"."topic_id" IS NULL AND "content_items"."chapter_id" IS NULL)
      )

material_enhancement_mappings_single_ent.name: material_enhancement_mappings_single_entity
material_enhancement_mappings_single_ent.value:
(
        ("material_enhancement_segment_mappings"."type" = 'subject' AND "material_enhancement_segment_mappings"."subject_id" IS NOT NULL AND "material_enhancement_segment_mappings"."chapter_id" IS NULL AND "material_enhancement_segment_mappings"."topic_id" IS NULL AND "material_enhancement_segment_mappings"."unit_title" IS NULL)
        OR ("material_enhancement_segment_mappings"."type" = 'chapter' AND "material_enhancement_segment_mappings"."chapter_id" IS NOT NULL AND "material_enhancement_segment_mappings"."topic_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("material_enhancement_segment_mappings"."type" = 'topic' AND "material_enhancement_segment_mappings"."topic_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("material_enhancement_segment_mappings"."type" = 'unit' AND "material_enhancement_segment_mappings"."syllabus_id" IS NOT NULL AND "material_enhancement_segment_mappings"."unit_title" IS NOT NULL AND "material_enhancement_segment_mappings"."chapter_id" IS NULL AND "material_enhancement_segment_mappings"."topic_id" IS NULL)
      )

materials_scope_chain.name: materials_scope_chain
materials_scope_chain.value:
(
        "materials"."subject_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND ("materials"."topic_id" IS NULL OR "materials"."chapter_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )

materials_source_consistency.name: materials_source_consistency
materials_source_consistency.value:
(
        CASE "materials"."source_type"
          WHEN 'UPLOAD' THEN "materials"."file_name" IS NOT NULL AND "materials"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL
          WHEN 'TEXT' THEN "materials"."text_content" IS NOT NULL
          ELSE true
        END
      )
